reader.requirement: At --std 85 GENERATE data-name-1 performs detail processing (control-break processing, SUM, the detail's USE procedure) for the named detail and normally presents it; presentation is withheld only where the text provides (SUPPRESS, a dummy group).

DialectBehavior.GroupIndicateConsumedByIssuedGenerate (GROUP INDICATE consumed only by a presentation at 85); the break detection, save and CH/CF ordering beside it is one arm for every edition

reader.notes: EmitGenerate calls Generate(detail), which runs the break processing and PresentBody(detail); the 85 arm on GROUP INDICATE is the 1985 text's own reading and does not change whether the detail presents.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:XIII.4.3.4 GR2 and the detail processing it points to, §1985:XIII.3.20.4 GR11 a-e (subtotal, USE, then no presentation if SUPPRESS or not printable). Probes at --std 85: r2dum (a nonprintable DETAIL 'DUM' with no LINE clause, SUM N UPON DUM; GENERATE DTL OF R and GENERATE DTL IN R2 with DTL in two RDs): DUM never presented, its USE procedure ran each time with LINE-COUNTER unchanged (3,4,6), its SUM UPON counted 004 then 005, the qualified GENERATEs presented in the right report. r2sup (SUPPRESS PRINTING in USE BEFORE REPORTING DTL on N=1 and N=4, GROUP INDICATE item): suppressed details still summed (CFK 006, 009), GROUP INDICATE printed on the first PRESENTED detail after INITIATE and after the break (the 85 arm). cite: OK  §1985:XIII.4.3.4 GR2  (4.3.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR2; OK  §1985:XIII.3.20.4 GR11  (3.20.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR11.
